Assumptions and status

Source: vignettes/assumptions-status.Rmd
assumptions-status.Rmd

Product order in products() sets cutting priority. Recorded assumptions and status codes support checking a run before summarizing its logs.

## Select example trees
trees <- example_trees %>%
  slice_head(n = 3)

## Define domestic saw specifications
domestic_saw <- product(product = 'domestic_saw',  ## product name, unitless
                        min_length = 16,  ## feet
                        max_length = 40,  ## feet
                        trim = 1,  ## feet
                        min_sed = 6,  ## inches
                        volume_unit = 'scribner')  ## Scribner board feet

## Combine products in cutting priority order
specifications <- products(domestic_saw = domestic_saw)

## Cut and scale the trees
result <- merchandise(tree_id = trees$tree_id,
                      dbh = trees$dbh,
                      ht = trees$ht,
                      spcd = trees$spcd,
                      products = specifications)

Status

Only trees with nonzero status appear in status. A clean run returns an empty table.

## Show a clean status table
result$status
#> [1] tree_id     status      name        description
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)

## Introduce a missing diameter
bad_trees <- trees %>%
  mutate(dbh = if_else(condition = tree_id == first(x = tree_id),
                       true = NA_real_,
                       false = dbh))

## Cut and scale the trees
bad_result <- merchandise(tree_id = bad_trees$tree_id,
                          dbh = bad_trees$dbh,
                          ht = bad_trees$ht,
                          spcd = bad_trees$spcd,
                          products = specifications)

## Show the failed input row
bad_result$status
#>   tree_id status          name                                   description
#> 1       1      1 missing_input A required input is missing or is not finite.

Structural errors, such as duplicate identifiers or unknown product fields, stop the call.

## Look up the status descriptions
codes <- status_codes()
status name category description source
0 ok ok The requested measurement is available. stem model
1 missing_input input A required input is missing or is not finite. stem model
2 invalid_dbh input Diameter at breast height must be greater than zero and at most 400 inches. stem model
3 invalid_height input Total tree height must be greater than zero and at most 500 feet. stem model
4 height_out_of_range input The measurement height lies below ground or above the tree top. stem model
5 invalid_diameter input The requested diameter must be greater than zero. stem model
6 empty_stem_section input The lower boundary must be below the upper boundary. stem model
7 unknown_species input The species code is not recognized. stem model
8 outside_divisions input The location falls outside the shipped ecological division boundaries. stem model
50 unknown_model model The taper model identifier is not registered. stem model
51 missing_tree_measurement model The selected model needs an additional tree measurement. stem model
52 species_out_of_scope model The tree species is outside the model’s stated species range. stem model
53 measurement_unavailable model The selected model cannot supply this measurement. stem model
54 model_failed model The selected model did not return a valid measurement. stem model
55 auxiliary_out_of_domain model An auxiliary measurement is outside the model’s domain. stem model
100 diameter_above_tip height The requested diameter is smaller than the diameter at the tree top. stem model
101 diameter_below_stump height The requested diameter is larger than the diameter at the stump. stem model
102 multiple_heights height The same diameter occurs at more than one height and the highest was returned. stem model
400 no_entry_product product No product accepts this tree’s recorded attributes. merchandising
401 defect_height_out_of_range defect A defect height lies outside the tree. merchandising
402 defect_interval_invalid defect A defect section has reversed or equal bounds. merchandising
403 defect_percent_out_of_range defect A sweep percentage is missing, misplaced, or outside zero through 100. merchandising
404 model_unresolved model No taper equation was selected for this species. merchandising
405 defect_unknown_tree defect A defect names a tree that is not in the list. merchandising
407 defect_unknown_product defect A defect restricts to a product that is not in the products table. merchandising
408 invalid_pruned_height input The pruned height is negative, not finite, or above the tree. merchandising
409 defect_product_misplaced defect A product is named on a defect that is not a restriction. merchandising
410 no_feasible_log product The tree is valid but no log meets the product specifications. merchandising
411 invalid_stump_height input Stump height must be at least zero and below the tree height. merchandising
412 optimizer_failed product The value optimization did not complete for this tree. merchandising

Assumptions

assumptions() returns equation assignments, stump heights, and any inferred bark ratios recorded for the trees.

## Extract recorded assumptions
recorded <- assumptions(x = result)
tree_id assumption spcd model value (unit column) unit basis product source (abbreviated)
1 species_model 202 F00FW2W202 NA NA NA NA pinned source library
2 species_model 263 F03FW2W263 NA NA NA NA pinned source library
3 species_model 202 F00FW2W202 NA NA NA NA pinned source library
1 stump_height 202 F00FW2W202 1 feet NA NA stump_ht
2 stump_height 263 F03FW2W263 1 feet NA NA stump_ht
3 stump_height 202 F00FW2W202 1 feet NA NA stump_ht

Workers 

## Inspect the worker count
threads()
#> [1] 4

## Temporarily use a specified worker count
with_threads(n = 4,
             code = dib(dbh = trees$dbh,
                        ht = trees$ht,
                        h = 20,
                        spcd = trees$spcd)) %>%
  rename(`diameter inside bark (inches)` = value)
#>   diameter inside bark (inches) status
#> 1                       8.56020      0
#> 2                      11.00230      0
#> 3                      12.19541      0

with_threads() restores the previous count. MERCHANDISER_THREADS sets the initial count when the package loads.
